tasks.description: The rebuild contract: the 'Phone app rebuild (from 2026-10-07)' section in CLAUDE.md, word for word from the Notion Phase 0 page.
Control files: docs/rebuild/state.md, archive.md, feature_list.json, stack.md, streamlit_bound_tests.md, owner_checks.json, p0_proof.json, handoff/.
scripts/rebuild_gate.py (counters, HTML + JSON report, --update-features) and tests/test_rebuild_gate.py.
M1: requirements-engine.txt and -dev.txt (exact pins); the suite passes in .venv-engine (Python 3.12) with the Streamlit tests excluded.
M2: api/healthapi with GET /api/health and GET /api/readiness (caller's date, the Home-card computation), X-Engine-Key auth, one Repository per request, cache rebuilt at startup; tests/api/.
M3: Dockerfile (python 3.12 slim, OS tzdata, non-root), .dockerignore, .gcloudignore as an allow-list; the Cloud Build upload list holds no personal file.
app/ placeholder (Health + version line) and worker/ (Hono: assets, access key, pass-through with X-Engine-Key, JSON 503) with Worker and app tests; shared/openapi.json and generated TS types.
STOP 1, owner: Google Cloud CLI, billing, EUR 1 budget alert, the two Secret Manager secrets, wrangler login, the phone access key in .env.
M4: Cloud Run service health-engine (min 0, max 1 instance), secrets mounted, cache mode, TZ; Artifact Registry clean-up and a 7-day rule on the source bucket.
M7: the Worker deployed as 'health' with ACCESS_KEY, ENGINE_KEY and ENGINE_URL secrets; the placeholder opens on the iPhone.
M5: five forced cold starts, end to end through the Worker and direct, with the engine's own startup timings.
M6: the read-only Oura probe (no refresh, ever) and, with the owner's OK, one Garmin login and read from Cloud Run.
M8: billable time and requests from Cloud Monitoring, projected to a month against each free-tier figure.
No secret-shaped string in any tracked file.
After the owner's push, the hosted Streamlit app still opens.
The Phase 1 gate: the p1 counters in scripts/rebuild_gate.py (tests_failing, voice_refs_left, voice_libs_left, submodule_left, device_checklist_open), each with tests.

Owner: the standalone voice app on Streamlit Community Cloud from B-macs/health-voice-training, its secrets trimmed to [voxplot_supabase] (done 2026-10-19, after he restored its paused Supabase project).

Remove Voice Training from the health app's code: the 'sync' route in app.py, the nav item in nav.py, views/sync.py, and the docstrings that point at Voxplot paths. Docs are updated by hand (not counted).
Remove the voice_training/voxplot submodule: deinit, .gitmodules, the gitlink, .git/modules.
Remove the voice-only libraries (praat-parselmouth, scipy, soundfile, imageio-ffmpeg) from requirements.txt; requirements-engine.txt names none.
The main gate stays at or above its floor: no test exists only for the voice embedding, and the nav tests follow the new tab list.
After the owner's push, his phone checks: the health app has three tabs and no Voice Training; Home, Training and Insights work; the voice app opens from its own icon and records.
Screen inventory of every Streamlit feature with a KEEP, MOVE or DROP proposal (docs/rebuild/screen_inventory.md); the owner decided every row on 2026-10-19 (STOP 1).
Move each calculation that lives only in a view into services/ with its test (docs/rebuild/view_logic_moves.json); the Streamlit views then call the moved functions.
Fix the 21 inventory faults in the move, each with a test that fails without the fix (docs/rebuild/faults.json); F1 and F3 are also fixed in the live app.
The session save takes a complete session with caller-minted ids: the same save sent three times stores one session (tests/api/test_save_idempotency.py).

The background_writer setting in Supabase's config table: the Streamlit app checks it before its sync and its automatic writes; the engine refuses the sync, the Oura login and the automatic writes unless it reads 'engine' (tests/test_background_writer.py).
The API routers by screen with Pydantic models: every KEEP or MOVE row maps to an endpoint and a test, or to the phone alone with a reason (docs/rebuild/inventory_endpoints.json).
shared/openapi.json and the generated TypeScript types in app/src/generated/api.ts are current.
No API route reads the server's own day: the caller's date comes from X-Local-Date (rebuild rule 3).
Every API write goes through Repository's Supabase-first path; no API module imports sqlite3, supabase_store or the datastore writer (rebuild rule 5).
The main gate stays at or above its floor with tests/api included.
Deploy the engine to Cloud Run with the Phase 0 settings; after the push the owner confirms the hosted Streamlit app still works.
Design research (docs/rebuild/design_research.md): Oura, Whoop, Apple Fitness, Strong, Hevy and Lauscher; the sizes that read from 1.5 m in a gym.

Design tokens in light and dark (app/src/design/tokens.ts) and the screens on them: Today, the training screen mid-set, the Strength card, the tab bar. No colour or size outside the tokens. The owner saw three directions (A Calm, B Board, C Logbook) and asked for one Oura-style design instead (2026-10-19).
Seeded synthetic mock data (app/src/mock, app/scripts/make-mock.ts); never the owner's readings, because the repo and the preview address are public.
One strings file (app/src/strings.ts) that passes the jargon, hedge and Stage 1 scans of tests/.
Tests: the Python gate at the floor, and the app and Worker Vitest suites (contrast in both modes, tap targets of 44 pt or more, rem text sizes, tokens only, the mock equal to its generator).
The preview on the Worker's preview alias `design` and the report reports/rebuild/p3_bakeoff.html; the owner tries it on the iPhone and his choice is recorded in docs/rebuild/design.md.

Stack as Lauscher's, versions checked on npm and recorded in docs/rebuild/stack.md: Vite, React 19, TypeScript, vite-plugin-pwa (injectManifest), Dexie, wouter, Vitest with fake-indexeddb, Playwright (Chromium and the iPhone WebKit profile), @vite-pwa/assets-generator.

Install and first launch: the manifest (Health, standalone, the design's colours, icons and apple-touch-icon), the Add to Home Screen steps when not standalone, the access key pasted once and kept in IndexedDB (never in a URL), navigator.storage.persist() and estimate() shown in Settings.

The data layer (Dexie schema v1 with a migration plan): cache-first reads that never render blank, the outbox (ULIDs, in order, retried with backoff, removed only on the engine's yes), the session, settings and the debug log; every request sends the phone's day.
The service worker: the app shell opens offline; /api is never cached; an update waits while a training session runs and installs at the next open.
The service worker caches no /api answer (no /api route in its source, none in its caches in the browser test).

Navigation and frames: the tab bar; Today, Check-in (a sheet), Training, Insights and Settings render with the engine down; Settings has the version line, Eruda after seven taps, the debug log, the engine status and the outbox count.

The Worker: the key check, the engine's secret, no /api caching, a JSON error when the engine is starting or down; SYNC_ENABLED false until Phase 9 (no sync trigger: the owner's one sync a day at the first open, 2026-10-19).

The daily data check (adapted: the newest backup against the store, since Notion is a frozen archive): a read-only engine endpoint, a daily Cron Trigger, the last result in KV and in Settings; rows it reports missing are repaired with the owner's OK.
Deploy (engine revision and Worker), the address and the iPhone checklist; the owner's results in docs/rebuild/owner_checks.json (p4).

Today from the API: the three scores, the week strip, today's session card, the engine's verdict and sync notices; day navigation (arrows, the strip, a swipe), the day kept for the visit and decided by the engine (picked_on).

The detail screens: sleep (the fused night, stages, the night strip, movement, contributors, debt, the wake-time correction), readiness (contributors, key figures, the verdict) and strain (overall, the split by body area, '—' when not known); SVG charts with taps, no link and no reload.
The Sleep screen's all-or-nothing rule on the API answer and on the screen: no score, no night panel.
The check-in: the same fields as views/checkin.py, today and the three days before, saved through the outbox so it works offline; one per date (the engine merges).
scripts/rebuild_parity.py: the live API against services/ for the last 14 days, dates and field names only.
Every screen word in app/src/strings.ts passes the jargon, hedge and Stage 1 scans.

Tests: Vitest for each screen state (from the cache, refreshed, no score, engine down), Playwright for the day navigation and a check-in made offline and sent later, the Worker tests and the Python gate; deployed.
The owner's two mornings: the new app beside the Streamlit app, the scores and the night equal; on the second morning the check-in in the new app shows in the Streamlit app.

The session lives on the phone: GET /api/training/session downloads it whole at Start (every exercise as dosed today, its seeded numbers and captions, the pre-walked flow with the timer-start marks and the bells), the ids are minted once, and it is kept in the session table across a reload, an app kill and an app update; no network until Save.
Every training-session row of the inventory marked KEEP (T37-T102) is built and tested: the overview before Start, the guided flow and the save (docs/rebuild/app_rows.json).

No training or safety rule in app/src: the rule for when a timer starts by itself moved from the Training page into services/guided_flow.py (hold_starts_next, the walk's timer_starts), and the page asks it too.
Timers run on timestamps: after a simulated background no timer is off by over 1 s; a timer that ended while hidden says when it ended.
One idempotent save through the outbox with the ids minted at Start: the engine's three sends store one session, and the phone sends the same ids again after a lost answer.
The save carries every field the Streamlit save writes: the raw facts of each set, its time with the UTC offset, the rest's clock readings, the walk's Garmin minutes.
A warning shows only on an exercise the engine sent one for (Key Rule 20).
Every screen word passes the jargon, hedge and Stage 1 scans.

The owner's real gym session in the new app: airplane mode for two exercises, a locked phone during a rest, the timer read from 1.5 m, the bells with the silent switch on, the screen on, saved once (scripts/session_field_check.py).
